# Issue #1468 frozen sewing-pattern campaign

`manifest.json` seals all 12 cumulative ordered traces before any exploratory
compilation or evaluation. `F1.nui`–`F3.nui` are their initial sources.
`freeze.py` is independent design arithmetic, with no product imports or calls.
Every checkpoint includes exact source, SHA-256, expected source revision,
analytic geometry, physical bounds, page geometry and selected output paths.

A, B and C each start from a fresh canonical store; units within each series
continue the preceding source. C4 deliberately reopens a saved single file.
Module Preview has an ephemeral root with explicit Left arguments; Canvas
contains both authored instances and Right's outer placement recipe.

No campaign execution has occurred at sealing time. Unsupported spellings or
operations must be recorded as CONTRACT_INVALID; any legal equivalent requires
explicit documentation and a separately frozen source before execution.
Historical #1450–#1466 repairs are controls and cannot count as novel families.

Execution is recorded in [result.md](result.md). The executable admitted seal is
`visible-manifest.json`; `support-disposition.json` records the explicit legal
F2 equivalents and retains the original unsupported/hidden controls. Original
seals remain historical evidence, not silently rewritten executable fixtures.
